meeting_title.description: Concise, descriptive title for the meeting.

meeting_summary.description: Executive summary of the discussion in 2 to 4 concise sentences.

confirmed.description: True if officially agreed upon by the team; false if tentative or merely a proposal.

action_items.description: Action items and commitments identified in the meeting.

task.description: Actionable task starting with an active verb.

owner.description: Name of the assigned owner. Null if unassigned. Never invent.

deadline_phrase.description: The exact verbatim timing phrase spoken in the transcript (e.g. 'by Friday').

deadline_iso.description: Resolved deadline date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD), or null if missing, ambiguous, or unassigned.

status.description: Status classification of the action item.

source_quote.description: Verbatim short quote from the transcript proving the commitment or context.

confidence.description: Confidence score between 0.0 and 1.0 reflecting certainty of extraction.

open_questions.description: Unresolved questions, blockers, or dependencies requiring clarification.

related_task.description: Title of the related action item, or null.

responsible_person.description: Person assigned to investigate or provide an answer, or null.

updates_to_existing_tasks.description: Updates or progress reports regarding earlier open tasks from past meetings.

existing_task_id.description: The exact Task ID (e.g. TSK-1001) from earlier open tasks.

change.description: Type of update identified for the task.

new_deadline_iso.description: New target date in YYYY-MM-DD if deadline was changed, otherwise null.

evidence.description: Verbatim quote or proof from the transcript.
